profile.headline: Cloud | AWS | Kubernetes | Terraform | DevOps | Platform Engineering
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience building and deploying cloud-based applications across AWS and Azure environments. I specialize in backend development, API design, and cloud infrastructure automation, with hands-on experience supporting production systems in enterprise environments.

 

My work focuses on designing scalable services, improving deployment reliability through CI/CD automation, and aligning cloud architecture with business objectives. I’ve collaborated closely with cross-functional teams to deliver secure, resilient solutions that support real-world workloads.

 

I’m currently focused on expanding my expertise in cloud infrastructure, Infrastructure as Code, and platform engineering while continuing to build high-quality backend systems.

 

Open to cloud, backend, and infrastructure-focused opportunities.



If you would like to hear more from me, please reach out via email jerry.davis86@rocketmail.com.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Multi-Platform Application Developer aligning technology, related tools, & frameworks with business strategy. We work closely with onshore and/or directly with our clients. Reviewing code written by other programmers, requirement gathering, bug fixing, testing, documenting and implementing software systems to enhance functionality and streamline production.
positions.insights: Test Driven Development, AngularJS and +19 skills

positions.title: Senior  SW/App/Cloud Tech Support Analyst
positions.description:
Perform analysis of existing application protocols and software tools
Provide solutions for network and system related issues, and provide detailed documentation along with it
Assist customers by performing analysis of various issues relating to LANs, WANs, desktop computers, email, printing. operating systems and the installation of hardware and software
Provide application support in resolving and troubleshooting problems
Received “A-team” award recognition for an outstanding service and showing leadership DNA
Able to develop and deliver device activation and enablement training for 70+ clients that enhanced frontline employee performance

positions.title: POS Contract Support
positions.description:
Supported POS software, hardware development cycle to include requirement-based analysis
Performed functional testing, interpretation, and analysis of results of tests
Maintained technical knowledge related to hardware and software product lines and industry
Provided telephone, remote and on-site support for clients in order to provide quick resolution to problems
Collected analytics to automate 80% of our manually processed VAR accounts
Conserved the company $7000 quarterly in a critical situation following the acquisition of the Century Payment platform by processing equipment orders through Century force (Salesforce)
Assisted product engineers by identifying issues with the new software rollouts and conduct file configurations within Vericentre for new and existing customers across Worldpay, SecureNet and Century Payment platforms

positions.title: Technical Installation Engineer II
positions.description:
Worked as a member of Central Installation Response team and provided support in daily activity to a team of 20 call center agents as an extension of management, while offering one call resolutions to escalated issues
Performed planning, design, development, installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting processes as well as assisted with updating customer software drivers to expand online payment features
Responsible for checking and maintaining regular maintenance services in order to make sure that the construction is working right
Support relationship with customer installation group as required
Assisted in updating software such as Java, Flash player, Adobe reader to ensure functionality of payment system
Ran weekly project status reports to track POS downloads and agents’ daily installations

positions.title: Gaming Analyst
positions.locationName: 4150-B Blue Ridge Industrial Pkwy, Norcross, GA 30071
positions.description:
Provided and analyzed metrics on the performance of the games and marketing campaigns
Responsible for looking for bottlenecks in the project and finding points of its growth
Searched for possible problems, including the planning of experiments, calculation, and interpretation of the results
Documented software defects and checked bugs using bug tracking software
Used standard game testing methodologies to assist with the supporting team to handle testing of the game version
Developed a method to process payments remotely for gaming credits through proprietary system software

volunteerExperiences.description:
Personally designed implemented and supported small LAN for private boxing network
Purchased and distributed Symantec Antivirus Protection Software License
